title: FieldPoly batch evaluation via subproduct tree
description:
Add `batch_evaluate(&self, points: &[F]) -> Vec<F>` to `FieldPoly<F>` using the subproduct-tree algorithm (O(n log² n)).

## Algorithm

1. Leaves `M_i = x - point_i` (length 2).
2. Internal nodes: products of children (reuse `FieldPoly::mul` Karatsuba-enabled path).
3. Top-down reduction: reduce `self` modulo each internal subproduct (reuse `div_rem`).
4. Leaf values are the evaluations.

## API

- `pub fn batch_evaluate(&self, points: &[F]) -> Vec<F>`.
- Fallback to per-point Horner when `points.len() < 16` or `self.degree() < 16`; threshold as a named `const` tuned by the benchmark in `benches/field_poly.rs`.

## Success criteria

- Agreement proptest: `batch_evaluate(points) == points.iter().map(|p| evaluate(p)).collect()`.
- Unit tests: `k=1`, `k=2`, duplicate points, points containing zero, degree-0 polynomial.
- New criterion bench at `crates/gf2-core/benches/field_poly.rs` shows subproduct-tree beats k individual Horner evaluations for `k >= 16, n >= 16` on `Fp<65537>`. Commit measured results into the module docstring (mirror `batch_ops.rs`).
- `cargo fmt` / `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` / `cargo test --release` clean; budget ≤60s.
